purpose: Unit-normalized direct values in the frozen selected Mineral Resource, for descriptive comparisons within the same Census field and resource class. Not an operating comparison or MCDA eligibility.
scope: Only the same observation, project, source SHA, selected resource statement, estimate, page, quantity, category and material basis. All original direct-value, numeric reconciliation and eligibility checks remain active.

unit_mappings.label: M Tonnes
unit_mappings.basis: Mass column of a metric-tonnage resource table; uppercase SI M (mega) qualifies tonnes. Case is preserved. Applied only with selected whole-resource context and original/stored/published value agreement.

unit_mappings.label: million tonnes
unit_mappings.basis: SI prefix mega (10^6) applied to the metric tonne. Applicable to a complete bulk-resource mass expression; the ore-grade evidence and selected source are checked separately.

unit_mappings.label: tonnes
unit_mappings.basis: Written name of the metric tonne, with an explicitly identified mass and commodity. Does not apply to short or long tons.

quantity_mappings.label: reported_resource_ore_mt
quantity_mappings.basis: Same source-reported ore mass field and unit; ore resource support, source statement and selection checked separately.

quantity_mappings.label: reported_resource_grade_pct
quantity_mappings.basis: Source-reported resource grade; requires the existing verified TREO basis, field support and unit agreement.

quantity_mappings.label: reported_resource_grade
quantity_mappings.basis: Same reported grade variable only conditional on the verified TREO resource, original unit and selected direct cell.

quantity_mappings.label: reported_resource_contained_treo_kt
quantity_mappings.basis: Source-reported contained TREO; exact scope and native-to-published numeric agreement remain necessary.

marker_recovery.applies_to: Previously absent native token and unit on an existing resource observation, from a uniquely stated measure in its own page marker, or a complete source-marked table row and same-column native header. Requires the original hash-verified physical PDF page.
marker_recovery.excludes: Table headers in separate markers; cutoff and alternative statements; resource targets, reserves, subcomponent masses; any token or unit contradicted by previous source-bound values.

failure: Unsupported or ambiguous context, conflicting values and unavailable source identity/date/eligibility remain unresolved or blocked.
